==Ingredients==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Honey|Honey]]
* ¼–½ clove of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]

==Procedure==
# Chop chicken into small pieces. 
# Coat [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] with a thin layer of olive oil.
# Add chicken pieces to frying pan.
# Cover the chicken with honey and add garlic.
# Cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens and darkens and the chicken is cooked. Don't let it go on too long or the sauce can burn.
